name: cell-lct
description: 在 Adobe Illustrator 当前画板中生成、重绘和续画可编辑科研矢量图，包含完整本地执行运行时。

interface.shortDescription: 在当前画板中生成可编辑科研矢量图
interface.longDescription: 上传参考图片或描述研究内容，在当前 Adobe Illustrator 画板中生成、重绘和继续添加可编辑科研矢量图。插件包含矢量生成、结构验证、缓存播放和 Illustrator 原生路径运行时，并保留已有内容。
defaultPrompt: Use $cell-lct to draw one editable scientific vector subject in the current Illustrator canvas.
Use $cell-lct to recreate the uploaded reference as editable vectors in the current Illustrator canvas.
Use $cell-lct to continue drawing while preserving all existing canvas content.
